facts_rule: Same rule as round 2 (evals/repo_eval_keys_round2.json facts_rule): RepoFindings.facts of the used investigate calls (merged in plan order, earlier keys win) are compared with expected_facts key by key; correct iff every expected key matches. Missing key = mismatch; extra returned keys ignored. Dotted names match when equal or when the returned name ends with '.' + expected; sha strings by prefix; other strings exact and case-sensitive; numbers/booleans by ==; `value` with tuples as lists; list fields as sets in both directions (string items by the dotted-name rule, dict items when every expected key matches); `*_include` keys are subset checks.
